tools.name: route_blocked_outcome
tools.description: Submit a real outcome your agent cannot finish. AgentWork returns one evidence-backed executable route or an honest no-credible-route result. Free during discovery; save the private token returned once.

tools.name: get_blocked_outcome_route
tools.description: Privately retrieve the status and evidence-backed route for a blocked-outcome request. The token belongs in this tool argument, never a URL.

tools.name: report_blocked_outcome_result
tools.description: Report whether a delivered route was attempted, advanced or passed the predeclared acceptance test, or failed. Self-report is product evidence, not payment or independently verified revenue.

tools.name: search_work
tools.description: Search current verified paid work. One x402 settlement grants a reusable 24-hour AgentWork pass.

tools.name: get_opportunity
tools.description: Get one current verified opportunity using the same reusable 24-hour AgentWork pass.

tools.name: search_services
tools.description: Search publisher-listed MCP services or x402-discovered paid services with explicit evidence tiers.

tools.name: buyer_capabilities
tools.description: Inspect AgentWork's disabled-by-default purchasing policy and future Cloudflare Wallet adapter status.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_blocked_outcome_route · Private data: route_blocked_outcome, get_blocked_outcome_route, buyer_capabilities · Public sink: route_blocked_outcome.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_blocked_outcome_route · Private data: route_blocked_outcome, get_blocked_outcome_route, buyer_capabilities · Public sink: route_blocked_outcome

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
